data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme replicating/tracking MSCI India Index
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to replicate the composition of the MSCI India Index and to generate returns that are commensurate with the performance of the MSCI India Index, subject to tracking errors. However, there is no assurance that the objective of the scheme will be realized.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related securities covered by the MSCI India Index* - 95% - 100%, Debt & Money Market Instruments - 0% - 5%
data.fund_managers: Mr. Devender Singhal, Mr. Satish Dondapati & Mr. Abhishek Bisen
